lessons_used: Evidence remains thin for 7 kinds of change with only 1 test; rules are only stated when at least 2 tests agree.
'home, wait_info' and 'finish, new_screen' are helpful, supported by multiple winning tests (3 of 6 and 2 of 4 won, respectively).
'adoption, redesign' and 'sign_in, redesign' consistently hurt performance across tests.
No clear effect was seen for 'adoption, layout', 'adoption, notification', 'choose_path, layout', 'sign_in, hint', and 'sign_in, incentive', as all tests yielded no clear effect.
Results for 'choose_path, copy' and 'choose_path, hint' remain inconsistent across tests.
Predictions were often overly optimistic for unhelpful changes and underpredicted gains on unexpected winning tests.

candidates.title: Desktop Renderer Launch Status Counter
candidates.change: Display a real-time status counter for desktop rendering engine setup on the waiting screen so users know the app is actively loading.
candidates.why: Home step has a high mean waiting time (2336s) and support receives complaints about pets not showing or app stalling.

waiting.hint: Initializing graphics renderer and background desktop layer...

guard.reason: Adding status/progress info to the waiting screen is allowed within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from funnel wait times and support complaints; wait_info is a proven winning pattern.

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Pet Voice and Command Cheat Sheet Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated end-of-onboarding screen explaining how to summon, move, and talk to your desktop pet.
candidates.why: Multiple support emails mention post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.

new_pet_controls_overview.headline: How to Interact with Your Desktop Pet
new_pet_controls_overview.body: Learn how to summon, move, and talk with your new desktop companion.

components.text: Right-click pet for context menu options

guard.reason: Adding an interaction overview screen after home_intro is explicitly allowed.

candidates.score_note: Addresses support complaints; new_screen on finish step has consistent historical gains but requires building a new screen.

candidates.title: Desktop Display Mode Compatibility Wait Card
candidates.change: Show a display mode setup card on the waiting screen explaining background rendering checks.
candidates.why: Home screen mean load time is high (2336s) and users complain about pet visibility issues on desktop.

components.text: Optimizing desktop display overlay for your monitor...

guard.reason: Adding rendering check information to the waiting screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Directly targets high home wait time and support issues using a proven wait_info approach.

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Quick Command Overview Screen
candidates.change: Introduce a final onboarding screen highlighting key shortcuts and desktop interaction gestures.
candidates.why: Post-onboarding support emails show users are unclear on how to hide or talk to the pet.

new_pet_shortcuts_screen.headline: Quick Shortcuts & Gestures
new_pet_shortcuts_screen.body: Double-click to activate chat, hold Ctrl+Shift to drag your pet anywhere.

guard.reason: Adding a shortcuts screen after home_intro is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Well-supported by historical success for finish, new_screen changes, though adding screens has higher implementation cost.

candidates.title: Photo Generation Quality Alert Badge
candidates.change: Add a real-time quality alert badge on the photo upload screen explaining photo constraints to prevent pet generation failures.
candidates.why: Custom pet generation fails or looks wrong for multiple users during adoption (3 emails).

components.text: For best results, use well-lit front-facing photos

candidates.title: Guided Pet Companion Goal Selection Flow
candidates.change: Introduce an interactive goal selection step where users pick their primary use case before choosing a pet path.
candidates.why: Mean time on path selection is high (514s), indicating users are uncertain which path suits their goals.

new_goal_selection.headline: What brings you to Desktop Pet?
new_goal_selection.body: Choose your primary goal to help us tailor your pet experience.

guard.reason: Adding a goal selection step within onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: New flows carry high implementation cost and historically tend to reduce conversion rather than help.

candidates.title: Post Adoption Certificate Account Sign In Reorder
candidates.change: Reorder sign-in step to occur immediately after adoption certificate confirmation.
candidates.why: Adoption drops to 60.9% and users report missing pets after signing in again; securing account after naming pet connects account creation with pet ownership.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in to occur after the adoption certificate is explicitly allowed.

candidates.score_note: Targets high drop-off step with strong multi-source evidence, but flow reordering lacks positive historical precedence.

candidates.title: Interactive Pet Personality Trait Selector Flow
candidates.change: Add a dedicated pet trait selection sub-flow during friend selection to customize pet behavior upfront.
candidates.why: Adoption has low conversion (60.9%) and long median time (89s), showing users want more meaningful customization options.

new_trait_picker.headline: Choose Your Pet's Personality
new_trait_picker.body: Select traits like Playful, Calm, or Focused.

guard.reason: Adding a personality trait selector sub-flow inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Targets largest funnel drop (adoption), but adding new sub-flows introduces friction and usually hurts conversion.

candidates.title: Desktop Docking & Placement Tutorial Screen
candidates.change: Add a post-adoption visual tutorial screen demonstrating how the pet sits on taskbars and multi-monitor setups.
candidates.why: Multiple support tickets report pets not appearing on desktop or misbehaving desktop features after setup.

new_docking_tutorial.headline: Desktop Placement Guide
new_docking_tutorial.body: Your pet can rest on your taskbar or float across monitors.

guard.reason: Adding a docking tutorial screen after home_intro is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Solves reported support issues with a reliable finish screen addition strategy.

candidates.title: Story Scroll Desktop Companion Highlight Hint
candidates.change: Add an overlay hint on the story screen highlighting how desktop pets run unobtrusively in the background.
candidates.why: Median time on story/choose_path is quick but mean is high (514s), showing some users hesitate before starting path choice.

story.hint: Desktop pets stay lightweight and won't slow down your computer.

guard.reason: Adding a hint overlay on the story screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Low cost hint on high-drop step, but historical performance for choose_path hints remains inconsistent.
